description: PAID $0.02 (x402, USDC on Base or Solana). Is a Hyperliquid prediction market on a crypto or stock price cheap or expensive? For every live binary price outcome on one asset: bid, ask, depth, the probability implied by the live perp price and 7d realized vol, edge in pp vs bid and ask, liquidity flag and signal. Bad input or no live market is a free error. Data, not advice.

asset.description: Underlying perp, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE, SP500, META (default BTC)

min_depth_usd.description: Hide markets with less USDC within 5 pp of the touch on either side; default 0
